682.note_text: 1: The result of a calibration permits either assignment of values of measurands to the indications or the determination of corrections with respect to indications. 2: A calibration may also determine other metrological properties such as the effect of influence quantities. 3: The result of a calibration may be recorded in a document, sometimes called calibration certificate or calibration report

680.note_text: set of operations that establish, under specified conditions, the relationship between values of quantities indicated by a measuring instrument or measuring system, or values represented by a material measure or a reference material, and the corresponding values realized by standards
